what: A single password field and a pill button. On open, a text caret stands in the field. Hovering the button fills only the background with the accent color over .5s ease (text color changes instantly). Entering a wrong word and pressing empties the field, the placeholder switches to the ‹wrong› text in the danger color, and the button turns a danger background with background-colored text. Hovering after a wrong try, the accent color wins. On a correct entry, data-state=open and fx:open

options.answer: Correct answer, default none (anything entered counts as wrong — for when the server or the consuming side does the judging)
options.wrong: Placeholder text for a wrong answer, default is the cell’s data-wrong, otherwise the first placeholder
options.dur: Seconds for the button background to fill, default 0.5
options.focus: When off, no focus is given to the field on open
options.reset: On input, the error mark is cleared when typing starts again. By default it stays until the next submit (original)
options.--fx-hover: Button background on interaction (via style), default var(--kf-accent)

use: <form data-fx="password-gate" data-fx-password-gate="answer: 0000"><input type="password" data-fx-part="field" placeholder="Password" data-wrong="Wrong password"><button data-fx-part="submit">Unlock</button></form> — Events fx:open · fx:error

from.where: index.html .bs-gate (shop password entrance — original input[type=submit] hover background .5s ease, .login-error red)

note: The error color is the standard --kf-danger (--kf-accent-text if the skin lacks it). The original applied hover only to .desktop by detecting the user’s device — here (hover: hover) gives the same meaning
